**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. body:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261031-1&t=1&akid=4219%2E587540%2EM9QwLy)
Happy Halloween, Peter! 👻
I’d tell you what my costume is, but I’ve been on the road so long this month that I think I’m actually just becoming a zombie.
Seriously, I’m running on gas station coffee and those peanut butter Reese’s pumpkins. But if there were ever a reason to keep going, it’s seeing the genuine hope and energy our endorsed candidates are inspiring in young voters across the country.
And speaking of spooky stuff: people love to argue about what’s scariest on Halloween. Ghosts? Witches? Clowns? The candy corn industrial complex?
Honestly, none of the above.
**What’s _really_ spine chilling is waking up on Wednesday to the GOP still in the majority in Congress and state legislatures.** The same rubber stamp for Trump’s authoritarian agenda. The same corporate PACs and billionaires writing the rules. The same gas, grocery, and healthcare costs crushing working families — and none of our progressive candidates in power to fight back.
Now THAT is nightmare fuel.
**The good news is, our slate of bold, young leaders aren’t afraid of monsters** — _even the ones bankrolled by corporate PAC money_. They’re going to flip seats and break GOP supermajorities without taking a dime from anyone trying to buy their vote.
And that’s not just about banking another win. It’s about stopping abortion bans in their tracks, overruling unfair election maps, lowering the cost of living, protecting our neighbors from ICE’s terror, holding Donald Trump accountable, and giving people hope for the future.
But our candidates can’t finish their fights alone. Our final fundraising deadline hits at midnight tonight, and it’s the very last one before Election Day. We need your help to close it out strong and make sure our candidates have the support they need to turn out as many voters as possible before polls close on Tuesday.
Your $5 could be the difference between flipping a red seat blue, and a skeleton of what could’ve been.
(Okay, that one was pretty bad.)
Terrible jokes aside, I’d really appreciate your support tonight. What’s really spine chilling is waking up on Wednesday to the GOP still in the majority in Congress and state legislatures. The same rubber stamp for Trump’s authoritarian agenda. The same corporate PACs and billionaires writing the rules. The same gas, grocery, and healthcare costs crushing working families — and none of our progressive candidates in power to fight back. Now THAT is nightmare fuel. The good news is, our slate of bold, young leaders aren’t afraid of monsters — even the ones bankrolled by corporate PAC money. They’re going to flip seats and break GOP supermajorities without taking a dime from anyone trying to buy their vote. And that’s not just about banking another win. It’s about stopping abortion bans in their tracks, overruling unfair election maps, lowering the cost of living, protecting our neighbors from ICE’s terror, holding Donald Trump accountable, and giving people hope for the future. But our candidates can’t finish their fights alone. Our final fundraising deadline hits at midnight tonight, and it’s the very last one before Election Day. We need your help to close it out strong and make sure our candidates have the support they need to turn out as many voters as possible before polls close on Tuesday. Your $5 could be the difference between flipping a red seat blue, and a skeleton of what could’ve been. (Okay, that one was pretty bad.) Terrible jokes aside, I’d really appreciate your support tonight. None of our work would be possible without you. Thank you for your support, and have a very Happy Halloween! 🎃 — David

subject: I'm sorry to ask again

body:
Not what I spent my time doing

Not what I spent my time doing
|
Peter,
I'll be honest with you... I'm not great at asking for money. It's the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn't spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn't become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That's really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it's going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. I couldn't just sit there.](https://trk.email.repdailyred._-ZjAhQiDA1GcgjNDwA)
But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don't have a massive machine behind me. I don't have someone who can write blank checks on a whim.
[I just have normal folks like you.](https://trk.email.repdailyred._-umPwdaihMa5bAPg)
I know things are tight right now. I see it at the grocery store just like you do. But if you can spare even $5 to help keep a Navy Vet and a Nurse Practitioner in this fight, it would mean the world to me.

body:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3095?t=1&akid=5795%2E35263%2EEIgPgI)
Peter,
As we prepare for the final stretch of the Election, my team and I are working hard to take back the Senate and support democrats up and down the ballot in Wisconsin.
**We’re launching a 24-hour goal of raising $25,000 by tonight at midnight! This is our final goal before Election Day.[Will you rush a donation right now to help us fight back in this final push? ](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261031-eom.V-vam-&amount=10&refcode=em20261031-5795&t=2&akid=5795%2E35263%2EEIgPgI)**

I’ll be direct: if we fall short, Wisconsin Democrats lose ground in the final stretch of this election.
**I know you haven’t chipped in to our campaign yet, but I’m hoping you’ll consider helping us in these final hours.**
**Here’s what we’re up against:** Elon Musk and the national GOP are spending millions to flip Wisconsin red and hold their majority in Congress. They have the money to saturate our airwaves, and they’re counting on us to run out of time.
And time is running out. Ballots are already being cast across Wisconsin, so our window to reach undecided voters is closing fast. Every voter who casts a ballot before we reach them is one we can’t win back.
That’s why I’m reaching out to my biggest supporters, which means you, for help during this crucial time. Your gift tonight helps us reach our 24-hour October goal and keep our Wisconsin Democratic nominees competitive all the way through Election Day.
**[Peter, will you chip in right now to help us reach this goal and close the gap? I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t critical.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261031-eom.V-vam-&amount=10&refcode=em20261031-5795&t=4&akid=5795%2E35263%2EEIgPgI)**

Thank you,
Tammy

name: Roy Cooper
subject: You’re one in a million, Peter
body:
I’m not reaching out to everyone. Just a select few, like you.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1687&source=&t=1&akid=5119%2E124072%2ExJS3oO) | | | | | | Peter, I’m not reaching out to everyone today. Just a select few, like you.
---
My team was going through our supporter records, and took particular notice of yours – because it showed that YOU are one of my most attentive grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest on this election. I want you to know that _I know_ how engaged you’ve been with our campaign and how much I appreciate it.
**Today, I’m asking you to take the next step by** [**_making your first donation of $5_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1687&amount=5&t=9&akid=5119%2E124072%2ExJS3oO)**– here’s why:**
Grassroots support has taken a nosedive today, and at the worst possible time. Republican super PACs have spent millions in North Carolina just to defeat me, and President Trump has personally intervened on behalf of his hand-picked MAGA candidate, Michael Whatley.
So with our final end-of-month deadline of the race tonight, we need to turn this around fast – and the first step is getting back on track to reach our $5 million goal by 11:59 p.m. [**_Will you please chip in $5 right now to help us get there in time? I’m not exaggerating when I say that the stakes couldn’t be higher:_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1687&amount=5&t=10&akid=5119%2E124072%2ExJS3oO)
See, North Carolina is the best chance Democrats have to flip one of the four seats we need to take back the Senate. **But if we lose here, we lose our shot at flipping the majority.**
The best way we can avoid the latter is by proving that North Carolina cannot be bought so easily.
Unlike Michael Whatley, I’m not a career GOP operative and Washington DC insider who can count on his billionaire connections to bankroll his campaign. I’m depending on people like you, giving what you can, when you can, at crucial moments like this.
_With just three days left until Election Day, I need you by my side._
Since time’s running out, Peter, I’m personally asking: [**_Can you chip in your first $5 donation today so we can reach our ambitious $5 million goal, flip North Carolina’s critical seat and help Democrats secure the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1687&amount=5&t=11&akid=5119%2E124072%2ExJS3oO)

Roy

Happy Halloween, Peter!

1\. **We wake up on November 4th to the best treat: Democrats took back the House and Senate on Election Day!** Voters across the country show up and make a clear statement to Trump and MAGA Republicans: We refuse to put up with their corruption and lies any longer. We have the power to hold them accountable. We have enough strength to begin passing important legislation. We immediately start working toward Medicare for All, just immigration reform, and critical AI guardrails.

Trump continues to ignore the law and put his own interests over the American people. _We need to be sure this nightmare doesn’t become a reality_.
In just a few days, we have an important choice to make. The polls might be looking good for our movement, but there's no guarantee that will translate to voter turnout.
**That’s why it’s absolutely critical we meet our final end-of-month fundraising goal.** Our entire movement will be pounding the pavement these last 3 days, making sure that our message is heard here in Seattle and all across the country.

subject: The Final Weekend Is Here. Make Your Voice Heard.
body:
Time's Running Out! Ensure Your Voice is Heard in This Crucial Election.
| | | | |
---
| Friends,
The final weekend before Election Day is here, and the stakes couldn't be higher for Northwest Ohio.
After months of campaigning, thousands of conversations with voters, and countless miles traveled across our district, we're approaching the moment that matters most: ELECTION DAY.
This election will determine who represents Northwest Ohio in Congress and helps make decisions about our economy, our communities, and our country's future.
Tomorrow, Sunday, November 1, is the LAST DAY of early voting in Ohio.
If you haven't voted yet, now is the time to make your plan.
Whether you vote early or on Election Day, November 3, your participation matters.
Every election is decided by the people who show up. In a competitive race like ours, every single vote is important.
Don't sit this election out. Make your voice heard.
Thank you for being part of this campaign and for taking the time to participate in this important election.
Derek Merrin

In good hands
| Peter,
Throughout my life, my hands have done a lot of different things!

[](https://trk.email.repdailyred._W8fpMVw)

---

They are furious that we have the White House, the Senate, and the House. They are desperate to break our Republican majority and stop the America First agenda cold. I am their #1 target to flip the House.
I'm humbly asking you to lend me a hand. I can't fight the liberal dark money machine alone.

## Tennessee Targets Youth Gambling with $3M
The Tennessee Department of Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services is offering [$3 million in grants to fight youth gambling](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuwzAMBuDT2JsCvfwaNHTxlq4dDUqibaGyFFhMgty-UID2Ah2JH_zBj1_X5QohhrR9woGGaF0SPktEIjwXAvdds1e-077BYetQKMdFctkzwZkSCzgKD1w0tN5YKSbQrkUjhklpLRQf291YJzl3TutOjr3Uazf6YezWcbKqB9W5NphaKLgSgvNR9hdnB7FO3qqul2Pnp0Zz9IHyeaEdCVPCUhDX-MoPPC8uH200O9GtNOqjkXMjZ2UP9AGqpuaNnP_WWIR7cjsWptgRYgw5se2ERCykQAGqh1Fmbz6yt5798hkkz-AJJ9ayRs7tafztWWtKPzSabweE-D6J_vnPh5E_AQAA___RVI3F), with a state survey showing the average young gambler starts at about age 12. That 2024-25 survey of more than 11,000 students in 34 counties found [15% had gambled in the past month](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFutDAQBOCnMd0hr-0DU7j4G7r725RoMQu2YvDJ3oDu7aNLlzrlaKRPmvl4TA-MKR7bf9zJMa_TQVdNxExlYvSf7-6VvzhsuM_vUDmnSUnV3UDeNEzoOZ40GWwWNysY0PiGHPSDNga0tE1wxvphkR6tl50FDyAN2FVLvPfrAKtvonuDIDWAlFZ1rZ97WIdl1vdO2fsyCCNpiZxLy4GYjoNqJVrTK59UWp_3JrnA_KxC_xNqFGq8rqvlo93yKdQ4U8Az5oLpFggTB6HGX6MKPXPhprjlecWUYu16YeS2Y0w_Ov_xmtOp7wAAAP__gwh6mw), and 43% of those gambled on six or more days. Kids find it through sports betting content, apps, video games, and illegal betting sites. Public agencies, nonprofits, colleges, and licensed providers can [apply for the money](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpTAMhZ8mdEH5AS4UKbahm223RE5iSLQhuUo8oHn7FSPtE0xjybLk853vz8f2ATHFfPyGEw3RvmW8W0IirBuB-_vcvsonhQNO-yyNStqUUBOXgmu5gaN44TZA541VcoHBdWjka9HDILWYu2C8lULN4Her90mOi9Je4jh79_JuGNF20TwPpdBSCjGrqXf2JffFWz1Oah79wgaBPlKpPQUkzBlbQ9zTV7mw9q6cXTKB6N2Y_sXUytR633dPuT_KxdRqMcAVS4XEA0KiwNT69GRqfYKZWqVgatXPIH-GBo1DzuUzO2yc65PDBTGBTcj3Uvm3EP7fCH9XvDBTLJlD9hxuqPgQ9oHO1FXj33dMKbbpxQZxnBDTNzL90Pdl1L8AAAD__0oAl7E), with $1.5 million set aside as yearly funding and $1.5 million as one-time money. Mary Beth Thomas, who leads the state’s Sports Wagering Council, said illegal sites “prey upon our youth” by not keeping minors out. A 5% cut of the tax on [licensed sportsbooks](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLsOnDAURL_GdCA_eLlwkYZu06ZE1-aCrdgY2XdB-_fRRsoXpByNNJpzfr3WF4QYzuMnJDRE-3riUyMSYVkJ3O9v98lv8gck-w2Vclwll2MreKvECo7CjWsPzWasFBp616ARk1Z9LxSfG2-w11JvMA3SzVZPoISchALQo913PkxNMN9BwZUQnM9y7JydxK43q4ZRzsOmWc9xC5RLRx4JzxNrRdzjJ99YOpdTE40nuipTP5hcmFye5-no7I58M7lY9HCHXCC2HiGSZ3Kpb1sJToct2HfFtmK5g8PK5EIFgRKexORylWwjpvYffnuVfBRItfOUYlPMdj0hxlDHifX8SBDi3z_0nzJvI_8EAAD__2aKjRI) pays for the grants. It also funds free counseling through The Gambling Clinic in Memphis, Nashville, and Johnson City, or by telehealth.
## Lee Questions Immigrant License Denials
Gov. Bill Lee said Wednesday he’s looking into why Tennessee [stopped issuing driver’s licenses](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O5CAQhJ8GZ4wA_xIQXOJsLr3QwtC2WwYzgh5b8_Ynb7DafLP--VRVqn_P6Wkx4LH-tREM0TIdcJUARJAnsm6_f5_0pm21cb6XQilMSqiOS8FrOVlHeMLU2MqbWUltG1eBkb2um0bWYqg24-dWDdq5etZSL0Nnh84K17pB-0XpxVVobkEpaimFGFT3cHMvF-3nuu3U0HrNGgEeKeUHbUBwHFAKwBI-6YT8cClWwWxEr8LqP0yNTI3fUEhpT2-6IabG24epUYp77n9yfA7J7YX7jCfkwgM6OAoUvqTMfQYb72uiDTLHGHHN9qDCL6SNv3nhV8o7f0GOSIWpscrGvy4MAUvXs0as0WL4Skq_rPk06n8AAAD__63dlU8) to immigrants with federal work permits. Since Oct. 1, hundreds of [Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) recipients](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOnTAQhE8D3T7ZhoehcJGG7k-bEhl7ACvGPNn7g7h9RIpcIOXujD7NzK-v6cuGGNL60-4wzMuUcJUIZuSJrfv9aPfxzdtq9_k5Ch9xUkJ1JAU1crKOw4mptbU3s5KDbV0NI_XQtK1sRF9vZlgGr2W3CN0rQLRzB41e29kuXuoOdTAPUIpGSiF61b3crOUy-Ll5d6p_-6FqBXzgI794AyMllAIs8T5O5Jc79jqajflTquZHpcZKjdd1vZ4qbrMpIb4fU6XG51WpcftOPsMXOhb6hyNvnaUMFz4BiQsVexNvuDNoRkgreaQATz6HE7lQDA6pgDISLhsLlZAc6HBMss7Gf64QYyidrlqx7jbEv0n5P2c-jfoTAAD__yZNl1Q) say they’ve been turned away, though many renewed for years using their work permit as proof of legal status. Thousands more could be denied at their next renewal. The Department of Safety and Homeland Security points to a 2025 state law, effective Jan. 1, [requiring proof of a specific period of authorized stay](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuwzAMAF8jbw5EynHiQUMXb-na0aAlKhYqy4HEOsjvC7dAP9DtCBJ3AD9u041iivn-TitbkTBlftbEIlwmIfd57F7blyx3WudjqLKlCTX2LejWwERO4s5TR423M8JAnWvYwmUwXQdGX5vFsqY-OAxozGAAyQw8O3AzaPQhGNNEewhBGwCtr9if3HyBMPjZnHu8nv2gOs0-ylZOsrBwzlwrc0ivbedyctvaJLuIPKoybwpHhWOmuuwxJZ4p598bheORUTiCPvigP1fryVHrS9y51DZFx7lyWzjzk1JVODbF-sczphRrf1Gdvq8U009a_vm33eJ3AAAA___6oIKy). Spokesperson Jason Pack said a work permit “does not provide sufficient information to verify an applicant’s lawful status.” Rep. John Ray Clemmons, who chairs the House Democratic Caucus, [called the denials “devastating”](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkDHPnDAMhn9N2HxKAgQYMnRh-7p2RCHxQXQmuRLDiX9f0aHq_m22nkf2q_fX1_TlIsW0_HQbWubnlPBTCJlxn9j5182ufPC6uG2-l8KZJi21ASWhVpPzHE-cGlcFO2s1uMZXaFU31E2jatlXq21McL0fvDbKtLLGPvROdgO2Ure6M6qK9j6oZK2UlL02Dz936jmEuW6N7tswiEZiiJz3B6_ImBKWgvikK5-4P3zeKrIr87uI-ofQo9DjP4lyfuWDb0no8f4j9KjkPQ__e7DkEwgRfh9YOOZUoLBjhP0gLBAwXTEtQNFjKliAM8Rti8vuEhcgXBzRBW4mvNEn7y-ICQ4oQo_VbsP7E4liMZ1o5LK5SH9j8zc7P63-EwAA___Pz5ic) for families who are “paying taxes just like everyone else.” Lee said he’d “just become aware” of the issue and wants to know whether state and federal law created “unintended consequences.”
## Nashville Shop Flags $500K Stolen Guitars
Metro police arrested a 38-year-old man Thursday who they say tried to collect up to $500,000 in [stolen vintage guitars from a Nashville shop](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O7CAMhZ-GdERAyF9BcZt0c9stI4c4CRoCI_AkmrdfscW-wJb2J1vnO1-P-QHOu7D_hxMN0TYHvLNHIkwzgX0W9olvOnY4lzJkin5WQnVcCt7IGSy5C2cN1WoWJUfQtkIj-7HRWjZiqA6zwGrbblj0uABsg5RC6BZAghiw7ZWqnCkPpWgKGlRX26WX27guTdupoV1HpgWujmKq6UDCEDBnxM1_4oWptvGsvDmIXpk1_5iamJru-65vICyQqalYMTX9njI1tUI8-eUCwY58fzuClHmxw8C3FE9uDyCCEOMOHKzFnGP6lG3acWVqqpJZX7fz3uWuZ1rsJzj_E4b-2ORl1HcAAAD__3_yiys). At least two people [brought the guitars to Carter’s Vintage Guitars](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOrDAMQL8mdEF58SpS3IZubrslMsFANCEZJR7Q_P2K1f7BlsdHsnz89Zge4IOP23840BKtU8SrBCTCPBG45-0-6U37Bsd8Q6EUJiVUy6XgWk7gyJ84GagWOys5gHEVWtkN2hipRV_tVugOB9d1uKJBtaBZZYOyByG0a3TjKm_vhVJoKYXoVVu7uZPrsMy6aVXfLAMzAhdPKde0I2GMWAriGj7pxFy7dFTB7kSvwvQ_pkamxuu66uuZ4y2ZGu8qpsaQHAT-CxHKfvoQkKmxEeLJTx8JNuTb2xPkwu9UjHzN6eBuByKIKW3AwTksJeXPPc0bLkyNVbbL6_Ih-NJ2zIjtAB9-LqM_vvW06jsAAP__tZWP4g) on 8th Avenue South on Oct. 17 hoping to sell them. The shop said they’d need an appraisal but put the initial value at $400,000 to $500,000. After the sellers left, Carter’s called police, who determined the guitars were stolen from Chattanooga. The shop then turned down the sale and was told the seller’s brother, “Niko Simpson,” would come pick them up. Brian Hart showed up Thursday claiming to be Simpson, and police said officers found a driver’s license in Simpson’s name on him. Hart first denied knowing the sellers before admitting the seller dropped him off, and he’s now charged with felony accessory after the fact.

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1913, the Lincoln Highway Association dedicated [the route of the Lincoln Highway](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFutDAQhJ8GOtCu7d_4Chd_c92lTYkMXvBGPnwyK068fXSRohQp084nzYy-99t4C5x5W9_CnbwsZdzouWcSoTpWmkuNcz0fUiTRIjGcmdckowJlO4RO4xhm4YNGbKNfiBTpljwOF22Mstq2yStLdoYQyKGDCQIhqmlybgAYjLXYsn_VIWhE0KCG3lzchMMyWffPTSGaxgBFllL7j8Lb60k-y0G1n8u9zT6JPPZG_2_UtVHXxGt6hnPvY5F-LcdP1CXepdSzUdeVNqohd79J5m0uefsmbfXx8eScebdDY2C9B85fu_I3W4dXnwEAAP__ZCSBKg), connecting Times Square in New York City to Lincoln Park in San Francisco.s It's that time of year again: Tomorrow morning you can sleep in an extra hour because the clocks will be [returning to standard time](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhSAQRb8GOw0MiFpQbGP3tt3SoIzKBuUFJhr_fsMm-wXbTTLJPefer9f0sj74c_u0Bxpa43TinQMSYZoSLjG5JT1virTjSs4-wW87TcBB14LXUkx2IX_hJCpnVkRAWaER3SCVAi11tRuN68D7DoRtXc_5MAMfXOe40sPcLmtbeVPiBJdCcMmha9TQz6JbZ923_WydYoqj8xRT8x39WUzCEy9MzRKPKpid6J2Z_GAwMhjv-26WOZca5c9gLCeD8U--zvby55Zr8gfWeLpcFz6DsUrGvW8fgs-6Y4pvh_XhF0L_m-Yy8BMAAP__VSB4Vw) overnight tonight, a shift welcomed by those who want early sunshine and disliked by those who enjoy later sunsets. How do you feel about it? Take our poll below and let us know. The toilet gets scrubbed every week. So why do scientists say it's one of the cleanest spots in the house? Today we count down the seven germiest things in the average home, and the toilet doesn't make the list. Which refrigerator drawer tested positive for salmonella and listeria? What morning ritual grows mold in half of homes? Why would a microbiologist rather make a sandwich next to the toilet than in most kitchens? Amy has the answers on today's episode of _The Flyover Podcast_. [Tune in here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykz71ugzAUxfGnsbcgf8WGwUOXbOna0TL2BVwZjC5XRLx9lapv0P3op_P_eoZnLLVs82dcwdPUwgavowIRYEBIDXPCa6dGC0yU41XLvFBQQtmbFDctQ0xUTgiSZz8BKNAcvHSDNkZZbfnis4hyGoYIzprYG6GzTGlwd52cheQ0L_7NSaGlFFoo15mhH6WbRtvf-zFmw4yAXKhh993K9n5Sr3YCdqmtvPqFaD-Y_mDqwdQDYcS45a5eTD3-hnvLCAk24ujz_iq1lsM6ZsS8xlJ_Gfpf_OnVTwAAAP__ma1vXg)! ## Daylight Saving Time Falls Back Tonight
Daylight saving time ends at [2 a.m. local time](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhSAQRb8GOw0MiFpQbGP3tt3SoIzKBuUFJhr_fsMm-wXbTTLJPefer9f0sj74c_u0Bxpa43TinQMSYZoSLjG5JT1virTjSs4-wW87TcBB14LXUkx2IX_hJCpnVkRAWaER3SCVAi11tRuN68D7DoRtXc_5MAMfXOe40sPcLmtbeVPiBJdCcMmha9TQz6JbZ923_WydYoqj8xRT8x39WUzCEy9MzRKPKpid6J2Z_GAwMhjv-26WOZca5c9gLCeD8U--zvby55Zr8gfWeLpcFz6DsUrGvW8fgs-6Y4pvh_XhF0L_m-Yy8BMAAP__VSB4Vw) on Sunday, when most of the country sets clocks back an hour and returns to standard time. The switch returns the hour lost in March and hands back [an extra hour](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpDAUhE9jMpD_wCZwsAlZb7ohMvgZ3srglv0E4vajHmlOMHFJVfV9_17zy2PCc_vrD3AU83zCXRMQQZkLrLmEtTxvyrRDpOCfhNtOs-RyaAVvlZj9SnjBLJrgIoAE1YATZlRay0ENze4MGN_bxQ62h8hX45dRmWGxMupgtBcNuk-d4EoIrrg0nR7tIkxcBtvbxQfNNIeAlEv3P-P5eZKefEHp1nw0ye1E78rUHyYnJqf7vrvH7zl_UianhBEqPQmYnHwhXBNUJqeQobY_PG31F55bS3hAC2do-ag1571R3U5HaooL7xtTwjoYpvl2eEzf4_Q7ZZeTXwEAAP__epiBMw) of sleep. It also puts sunset about an hour earlier, which means dark evening commutes until spring but earlier sunrises. ## Texas Posts What State Workers Earn
Texans can now look up what state employees earn in an [updated salary database](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OqzAQQOGnMV3Q-IcAhYvb0OW2W6IhHoJXxo7Gk5C8_WrzCtsffcX5uswXjCnm23_cyctrLXOmoyYSIZ6_ifldj8IpbPjIQoExZtl4NmDOJw0nq2e8SnzS7LAJfoEw6oa87kfrnOsG22wewPbDFe0yuL4D44JeiAwMHdlFhw6a6H85DVZrDRZsCys51EO3EvT9uIzKAYUohVvZSOiFdU3v8iRur2Vvkt9E7lXZf8pMykwVE3Kk2n5K4bg8MrWFb8pMge7IslOWqszUsA_3I6YU67lXDm47xvQx5a8vnt78BAAA___umHU8) reflecting pay as of Oct. 1, searchable by name or agency. It covers 154,795 workers across 116 agencies, with a $61,695 median and an $850,005 top salary. A year earlier, the state had 153,475 employees across 115 agencies, a $60,513 median, and an $800,005 top salary. Lawmakers [funded raises](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OqzAUBOCnMV0s_xHHhYvb0OW2W6IDPsBZGYNsh5C3XyX7CNt-Gs1I83Xv70CR0vwfVvT1nLY-4bNErBVz_405v8pzyzEs8EgVQwZKdcm9Eup6keKiZQ9jpQN7A03wgwhONuilddoY0950s3g3ODuGK4IYlQKrgzY3Ow3tAAiuDaYh_66TQksphRaaiwkNyFs7obDWDY4ZgYHqlnldsOIJZYqv7cDMx21tol9q3QvT_5jqmOqm9eTjDvwT5PN2_BpTXcSZClNdgUhpZKqbHxQwUsK3Ugp48n3Zm-zD_qQYqVwtM2JegeJnqv71osOrnwAAAP__NWh9aQ) for certain state positions in fiscal 2026. State auditors say raises approved in 2023 may have helped push [classified employee turnover](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6jAQRb_G6YjGY5OQwgXSUzp40nvFltEET4hXTozsIcDfr5b9hO1ucXWOdD5Ow4lCDOv1TAs7eU5pWPlRIotwHj4551d5pBz9TPdV2GcKq8x5QMBmp2Fn9EAXCRsPlirvRvCdrtjptjPW2v3BVLOj0aDnZiJEOFiGtunQ60lbpJFoP1bBfeM0GK01GDA1TGxJH_YTQ9t2Y6cssA-Sci0zCz-pTPGVNs71JS1VdLPIrShzVNgr7Aul-n2qr2lT2P8__v3Ht5SlKOx_1vm-jJyV6YNX5g82uxZMlZ2_PUKMoTStsnBdKMS3QH4bZnP4FQAA__-gRng4) to 15.4% in fiscal 2025, a 15-year low. #

This is urgent, Peter:
**Real Clear Politics just downgraded my Senate race in Minnesota to a _toss-up._**
[**We need to respond TODAY. Split an emergency donation of $10 between my campaign and Ruben Gallego to fuel our voter outreach efforts and flip the Senate blue >>**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-flanagan.bMnRbN&refcode=em261031-1-90&t=1&akid=4231%2E734936%2EGkKQpJ)
[CONTRIBUTE $10](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-flanagan.bMnRbN&refcode=em261031-1-90&amount=%2410&t=2&akid=4231%2E734936%2EGkKQpJ)
Peter, too many folks think this race is a safe bet.
But now that they’ve landed their top recruit in this race, MAGA Republicans are turning their sights on Minnesota.
They’re spending big here – and now the polls are dead tied, 🔵 42- 🔴 42.
**Minnesota could decide Senate control — which means if we lose, Trump and his goons are guaranteed to keep the majority. We can’t ignore this news.**
This shift means that we are now in one of the most competitive and critical Senate contests in the country.
We’ve overcome the odds before, Peter, but we’re going to work harder than ever before. We need to turn out every last Democrat, get our message of change to every undecided voter, and cover the state in staff and yard signs.
**Since I don’t accept a dime of corporate PAC money, I’m counting on you to get the resources we need to respond.**

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ea2bdff2-2551-435a-85ee-ded7e8575e34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
On a sunny late-July evening at Oakland's Lake Merritt, Jesse Rosemoore worked the shoreline handing out bright yellow stickers that read CANCEL PIEDMONT. A young jogger smiled and kept running: "Piedmont shouldn't be its own city!" Minutes later, a middle-aged Black woman studied the sticker and offered fair warning: "Don't feel bad if you get some pushback. People feel strongly about their small towns."
Both reactions are correct. That's what makes this strange little feud worth your attention.
**What is being "canceled," exactly?**
Piedmont is a 1.7-square-mile city of about 11,000 people -- towering oaks, ivy-covered mansions, and some of California's top-ranked public schools. It is also, uniquely in Northern California, an incorporated city completely encircled by another city. Oakland wraps around it like a doughnut around a hole, which is literally what locals call it: "Oakland's Doughnut Hole."
The stats explain the provocation. Piedmont's median home price is nearly $2.6 million, more than three and a half times Oakland's. The city is roughly 70% white and about 1% Black. Across the invisible line, one in five Oaklanders is Black. And the line isn't abstract: in places it separates next-door neighbors, so one house feeds into a wealthy city's schools and police department while the house beside it does not.
**A century of exclusion, in one address**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/54c50003-596e-46af-b0d7-d4d1c3546514?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Piedmont was born of catastrophe. After the 1906 earthquake, some of San Francisco's wealthiest families decamped to the wooded foothills overlooking Oakland. When Oakland moved to absorb the community, a coalition of artists, writers, and businessmen voted to incorporate instead -- preserving their large parcels and their grip on every major municipal decision. By the mid-1920s, Piedmont boasted more millionaires per square mile than any city in America.
One of those millionaires, briefly, was Sidney Dearing, a Black Seminole entrepreneur who owned Oakland's popular Creole Cafe jazz club. Because Black people were barred from buying homes in Piedmont, Dearing gave his mother-in-law $10,000 to purchase a four-bedroom house at 67 Wildwood Avenue, and his family moved in during January 1924.
What followed is among the ugliest stories in Bay Area housing history: repeated bombing attempts, a 500-person mob demanding the family leave, bricks through the front window, crosses burned on the lawn. In early 1925, Dearing sold the house to city officials who claimed they needed the lot for a new road. No road was ever built.
The story might have stayed buried had Piedmont resident Meghan Bennett not launched a website in June 2020, piecing the Dearings' history together from clippings and public records. Since then, Piedmont High School has held annual assemblies about the family, and the city commissioned a roughly $400,000 memorial by Oakland artist Walter Hood near the old home site.
That apology-in-progress has a hitch. In February, Dearing's great-granddaughter Jordana Ackerman of Oakland sued the city over what her attorneys call a fraudulent use of eminent domain -- seeking compensation for a 2,741-square-foot home now valued around $3 million. "I don't understand why it's spending so much on this memorial instead of compensating a family that was robbed," her lawyer Leah Aden told the Chronicle. "So, who is [the memorial] for?" It is the sharpest critique yet: memory without repair.
**What the sticker is actually asking**
Rosemoore, 44, is an Oakland transit planner with a punk-rock aesthetic and no illusions of annexation. Since June 2025 he has distributed thousands of stickers and sold hundreds of $10 T-shirts -- a tongue-in-cheek stunt that became a vehicle for interrogating the Bay Area's intertwined systems of race, wealth, housing, and local governance. He has nothing personal against Piedmonters. "I just want them to take a hard look at themselves."
He knows Oakland has no realistic shot at absorbing Piedmont; that would require Piedmonters' votes, and a former mayor once said proposing it would get him "tarred and feathered." (A group of high schoolers launched a satirical "Liberate Piedmont" movement back in 2012.) The real argument is subtler -- and it should make every wealthy enclave squirm, not just this one. Stephen Menendian of UC Berkeley's Othering and Belonging Institute puts it plainly: segregation used to look like a white neighborhood and a Black neighborhood within the same city. "Now, most segregation is felt between cities, rather than within them."
The municipal boundary has become the firewall. Incorporation is the redline that can't be rezoned -- drawn a century ago, defended ever since by school districts, police departments, and tax bases.
**The view from inside the doughnut hole**
Piedmonters, understandably, feel scapegoated. Mayor Betsy Smegal Andersen put it with an air of incredulity: "We seem to be the only Bay Area town with a campaign to have us canceled." She has a point. Atherton is nearly demographically identical -- about 67% white, around 1% Black -- and nobody has put it on stickers. Hillsborough, Los Altos Hills, and a slew of exclusive suburbs share the same playbook. As policy researcher Richard Rothstein told the Chronicle, Piedmont's problems aren't unique; "what's unique is the amount of backlash it's getting for them."
Defenders point to real work: a school district DEI director ("We're doing good work here. Stop judging us and let us just do the work"), implicit-bias consultants, the memorial, the assemblies. Critics call it performative. What would not be performative is housing -- and Piedmont's record there is thin: only 200 of its 3,947 units are multifamily, nearly all its zoning is single-family, and it lacks the commercial corridors neighbors have converted into homes.
The test is Moraga Canyon. Adopted last October after two years of meetings and environmental review, the plan would transform city-owned land on Piedmont's eastern edge into at least 132 homes -- 60 of them affordable to lower-income households.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/857ca334-a03d-492d-b0dc-2c2e6119d14c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Retiring planning director Kevin Jackson notes most resident opposition has centered on fire safety and evacuation routes -- "at least on the surface." Whether homes actually rise depends on finding a developer and holding the line when construction costs and pushback bite.
**The question the sticker asks**
Late that evening, Rosemoore handed a sticker to a young woman in a "Free Palestine" hat who had just started renting near the lake. She called Piedmont "really pretentious" -- then shrugged: "As a Latina who has lived in really bad areas my whole life, it's pretty sick. And I'm hopeful it'll only get better. I heard they might be building more apartments."
That's the whole debate in two sentences. "Cancel Piedmont" was never a policy proposal; Piedmont can't be canceled. It's a question aimed at the region's most visible target because the question is easiest to see there: What is a city for? Who gets to live in it? And when a community's wealth was built on exclusion -- documented, literal, cross-burning exclusion -- does apology suffice, or does repair?
The answer won't come from stickers, or from Atherton and Hillsborough escaping scrutiny while Piedmont absorbs the heat. It will come from whether Moraga Canyon's 132 homes get built, whether the Dearing family receives compensation and not just a memorial, and whether both people Rosemoore met at the lake were right: people do feel strongly about their small towns -- and that is precisely the problem.
This piece draws on Connor Letourneau's reporting for the San Francisco Chronicle (Aug. 10, 2026).

Patriot,

Most of what we send you is strategy: states, numbers, the plan to win. This one is about why we do this work at all. And that starts with Charlie Kirk.

Charlie launched Turning Point in the shadows of the Obama re-election campaign headquarters in Chicago. He was 18 years old.

Every established political force on the Left and the Right tried to stop him.

They failed.

What Charlie started grew into what is **the most influential activist organization in modern American history**.

We were privileged to work with him and be a part of this movement.

We joined Charlie because we believed our mission was the only viable way to save this country. Charlie was willing to do what nobody else in the conservative movement would do. He went looking for young Americans who cared enough about this country to act, and he gave them a reason to fight.

Then came 2020...

Under President Biden, we saw corruption, weaponization of the government, and a government promoting values that put Americans last.

Charlie was adamant that we do everything we could possibly do to fix this in 2024. **We DID IT** , and we must continue for 2026 and 2028 to have a shot at saving this country.

Now, it is on us to continue Charlie's vision and mission.

Every single day, we work to continue his legacy of recruiting, training, and mobilizing a new generation of citizens who love this country enough to do something about it.

That work does not stop at the campus gates. It's now changing the direction of the nation.

Right now, ballot chasers supported by Turning Point PAC are in the field in **states that will determine not just 2026, but the 2028 Presidential election**.

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**To receive your FREE Genesis DVD box set, please use the secure link here:**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/-genesis-free-dvd-offer](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuK3DAQRb9G3tno5dfCiwTbYUKmQ-JFlkItld0FsiQsuYf8fWjw_ECoXR04Rd375129a3Tot5veYcCUlA1WfTz-buAh4Wv2GI6sfc5h1YpT3pSMloIpbTI-QUld2KHmrFu7AgbW9kLKjnWieAx9Kztu-k7UvKeMtpQ29xpAi_regJZrgcPLx6hgjFNBRSWFlq3WDUgLtu7vRNIzWp2hQp_QQjIhxBgcZjSpCsdWuOGRc0xEfCF8JnxGv4bqgc4lqx1UYE_C5_L6plwPgNI-bRnWFQ4i5mSIGCntZXOjXPIf37-OP8dpWghvzryrFM7DABFjPEKKYDL67UI7WDx3IkbYNbprafQeNW6eiPE6qezTfsLgM_hMxPhtuk3L2zL_nib1qy3flqX8DKI4Bhs_0DlMTUsk3V72yoS9yP9bz3Pg_wIAAP__b7-f-A)

Troy Jackson here -- a while back I told you that most fundraising deadlines are bogus. I meant it. Nobody's "urgent quadruple match" ever flipped the Senate blue.

But I am going to explain why our final end-of-month fundraising deadline matters so much in the fight to defeat Susan Collins and flip the Senate. **[If you're already with me, chip in now to help us hit our $2,000,000 final end-of-month goal before midnight. ->](https://substack.com/redirect/77cdf663-94df-48e0-9a31-178a32864ada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Tomorrow morning, we will sit down and set the budget for the rest of the campaign based on how much we raised in October.

**How much we raise before then will decide:**

📺 How many TV ads we can afford to reach the 6% of undecided voters who will decide this election.

💵 **Whether or not we stand a chance against Susan Collins** and her $114 MILLION in MAGA and billionaire support, because if we lose, Democrats will fail to flip the Senate.
_**That 's it. No sky falling. Just math:**_ what's in the bank account at 11:59 PM decides what we can afford in the final four days, the days that will decide this election.
**[So if you were ever going to chip in, today is the day to do so. Our $2,000,000 final end-of-month fundraising goal is critically important. Can you give whatever you can before October ends so we can defeat Susan Collins once and for all?->](https://substack.com/redirect/77cdf663-94df-48e0-9a31-178a32864ada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CHIP IN NOW ->](https://substack.com/redirect/77cdf663-94df-48e0-9a31-178a32864ada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I won't pretend the world ends if you can't. But every dollar you send is a dollar of TV time we don't have to cede to them.

Solidarity forever,
Troy

Peter, The midterm elections are everywhere in the news. But right now, several of our top electoral priorities just aren’t getting enough attention — here are four
1. Wisconsin Governor: Wisconsin Republicans in the legislature have a long history of embracing election denial and pushing extreme voter suppression measures. It’s taken years to make progress toward fair maps. But on November 3rd, Republicans hope to win the governorship and roll back all that progress. Voters can ensure we continue to fight for fairness by electing David Crowley as governor. David is a pro-democracy champion who has dedicated his career to serving his community, improving citizens' lives, and protecting the rights of all Wisconsinites.
2. Pennsylvania Trifecta: In Pennsylvania, the state’s congressional redistricting process runs through both legislative chambers. By electing a pro-democracy state legislature, we can prevent Republicans from gerrymandering and block their efforts to steal unearned power in other states.
3. Missouri Ballot Measure: Missourians successfully mobilized to suspend the gerrymander Republicans passed last year, restoring the state’s prior map for the 2026 midterms. On Election Day, voters get to decide in a ballot measure whether to reject the manipulated map for good.
4. Michigan Supreme Court: In Michigan, the state supreme court is the final arbiter of state redistricting law and has already played a major role in map challenges. There’s a reason why people like Elon Musk have invested heavily in state supreme court races. A fair-maps majority on the court provides a critical backstop if maps are challenged.

Some of these elections could come down to the wire — we’ve seen a legislative majority hinge on a coin flip. What we do now could make the difference. clean_body: Whatever you’re able to give will make a BIG difference in this final stretch | Peter, The midterm elections are everywhere in the news. But right now, several of our top electoral priorities just aren’t getting enough attention — here are four 1. Wisconsin Governor: Wisconsin Republicans in the legislature have a long history of embracing election denial and pushing extreme voter suppression measures. It’s taken years to make progress toward fair maps. But on November 3rd, Republicans hope to win the governorship and roll back all that progress. Voters can ensure we continue to fight for fairness by electing David Crowley as governor. David is a pro-democracy champion who has dedicated his career to serving his community, improving citizens' lives, and protecting the rights of all Wisconsinites. 2. Pennsylvania Trifecta: In Pennsylvania, the state’s congressional redistricting process runs through both legislative chambers. By electing a pro-democracy state legislature, we can prevent Republicans from gerrymandering and block their efforts to steal unearned power in other states. 3. Missouri Ballot Measure: Missourians successfully mobilized to suspend the gerrymander Republicans passed last year, restoring the state’s prior map for the 2026 midterms. On Election Day, voters get to decide in a ballot measure whether to reject the manipulated map for good. 4. Michigan Supreme Court: In Michigan, the state supreme court is the final arbiter of state redistricting law and has already played a major role in map challenges. There’s a reason why people like Elon Musk have invested heavily in state supreme court races. A fair-maps majority on the court provides a critical backstop if maps are challenged. Some of these elections could come down to the wire — we’ve seen a legislative majority hinge on a coin flip. name: Chris Pappas
subject: Azerbaijan.
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9880%2E582294%2EGgfG35 ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9880%2E582294%2EGgfG35 ]Chris Pappas for Senate

At the GOP Senate debate, John Sununu told a roomful of Republicans he’s
running to send me back to “bussing tables” at my family’s “chicken
restaurant.” He meant it as an insult.

As if the people who work in restaurants — cooking your food, clearing
your plates, keeping family businesses alive — have something to be
embarrassed about.

My great-grandfather came to New Hampshire from Greece over a century ago
and opened a candy shop in Manchester. My family built it into a
restaurant that’s been serving our community ever since.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261031_4.HGtC8W&refcode=em20261031-4&t=1003&akid=9880%2E582294%2EGgfG35 ]Puritan Backroom sign

John Sununu was born into a political dynasty. His father was governor and
White House Chief of Staff. His brother was governor. John went to
Washington and then spent the next 17 years cashing in with Big Oil, Big
Pharma, and Wall Street.

Oh, and his family business invested in a literal gold mine in Azerbaijan
that sells minerals to China. He’s never had to work hard a day in his
life — and his comments at that debate prove exactly what he thinks of
people who do.

The people who bus tables, flip burgers, and run small businesses in New
Hampshire don’t need a senator who looks down on them. They need one who
comes from them.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261031_4.HGtC8W&amount=5&refcode=em20261031-4&t=1022&akid=9880%2E582294%2EGgfG35 ]Donate $5 »

John Sununu doesn’t know the real New Hampshire. I do. That’s why I’m
running for Senate.

— Chris Pappas

Dear Patriot,

Early one morning in November 2021, FBI agents showed up at my home
with a search warrant, and I asked to call my lawyer.

An agent handed me my phone and I unlocked it to make the call. THEN
HE TOOK IT RIGHT OUT OF MY HAND.

My name is James O'Keefe. I run O'Keefe Media Group, and for eighteen
years I have sent undercover reporters into rooms that do not want a
camera in them.

[James O'Keefe on the FBI affidavit. Stand with James. Donate now.]
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

For almost five years, the government's reasons for that raid were
sealed. This year a federal judge ruled that the secrecy had gone too
far, so the FBI's sworn affidavit is now public, and I have read every
page of it.

CHIP IN $35 TO DEFEND JAMES →
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

THE FBI ALREADY HAD MY EMAILS before it came to my door, because it
had used search warrants to collect them from Microsoft.

That means agents read the email I sent my team on October 12, 2020,
after a tipster brought us a diary that was said to belong to Joe
Biden's daughter. In it, I told my team we would not publish the
diary, because it was “INDEFENSIBLE TO PUBLISH WHAT WE CURRENTLY
HAVE.”

Nine days later I wrote to them again: “WE CAN'T PUBLISH THIS.”

The FBI quoted both of those emails in its own sworn affidavit, and
more than a year later, it raided my home anyway.

DONATE NOW →
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

The same agent swore that it “does not appear” my reporters
“ARE, IN FACT, CREDENTIALED JOURNALISTS.” Agents tracked my phone
to a hotel upstate and planned to wait until I came home, and they
even asked the judge for the power to press my fingers onto my phone
and hold it up to my face to unlock it.

And after all of that, THE GOVERNMENT NEVER CHARGED ME WITH A SINGLE
CRIME. The judge said so in her own order: “no criminal charges were
forthcoming.”

They never needed a conviction, because a raid works just as well if
it costs a reporter years of lawyers, money, and focus. Liberty Guard
runs the O'Keefe Defense Fund so that I can pay those lawyers and keep
doing the reporting they wanted to stop.

[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

public, because I want you to see them.

Please give whatever you are able to give right now.

In Truth,

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: I know this is a big ask, Peter
body:
Please give me a moment to explain.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I’m about to make an important ask of you:
With just three days left in this campaign, I am asking you to please **[make your first donation before it is too late. Even $1 would make an impact.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1992?c0=em_ms_gh_20261031_1_double.dJRTTf&%3Brefcode=em20261031-2611&t=6&akid=2611%2E299639%2E2fqUvL)**
Please give me a moment to explain why I’m making this request, and **why it will be one of my last.**
You see, Peter, we just learned that Elon Musk sent $5 million dollars to Greg Abbott so they can maintain their stranglehold on Texas. That money doesn’t just sit in a bank account. Those millions go directly towards more false TV ads about me, more paid canvassers knocking on doors of Abbott voters, and more billboards on every highway in this state – _all while voters are heading to the polls!_
We have to respond, or we risk losing everything we’ve built together. So my team and I had no choice but to *raise* our fundraising goal to combat this new $5 million Abbott has to spend against me.
I am so grateful that you’ve been following along with our campaign and opening emails like this one. You are the reason we’ve come this far. **But without a major surge of first-time donations from people like you who have yet to contribute to our campaign, we will get drowned out when it matters most.**
[**Can I count on you to make your first donation of any amount at all to fuel our campaign through these final three days and help us get out the vote?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261031_1_double.b94KcO&%3Brefcode=em20261031-2611&t=7&akid=2611%2E299639%2E2fqUvL)
Thank you for believing in me. Together, we will make history.
Yours truly,
Gina

Peter, at a recent town hall, a man named Tommy asked me this: _“Will you disavow the Muslim Brotherhood?”_ I said, “Yeah, absolutely.” Then I asked him why he was asking _me_ this. You already know the answer. He assumed that because I’m Muslim, my loyalty must belong to something other than the Constitution. I reminded Tommy that John F. Kennedy got asked whether he'd have allegiance to the Pope, because he was Catholic. Same question, same assumption. Peter, I’m not running to be a Muslim senator. I’m running for the U.S. Senate, and I happen to be Muslim. **The Constitution is my guiding light, and I’ll fight to protect the right to pray or not pray as you choose for _all_ Americans, including Tommy.** That clip has been viewed more than *44 million times* online. I think it went viral because of how perfectly it captures a core aspect of this race: **Republicans are attacking my faith because they have _nothing else to run on_.** Michiganders are paying too much for groceries, gas, and healthcare. And Mike Rogers has no real solutions to those issues. He’s simply running to be an errand boy for Donald Trump. So the same weekend as that town hall, Rogers ramped up his baseless Muslim Brotherhood attacks, and Donald Trump continued to mispronounce my name and try twisting it into a punchline. **They’re betting that if they make voters afraid of me, nobody will notice who’s actually been robbing them.** But a viral clip isn’t enough. With two weeks to go, Michigan voters need to hear the truth from us before the GOP’s attacks reach them. I’ve taken on corruption and special interests in Michigan before — and won.
I’m ready to do the same in Congress, but here’s the deal: this race is a true toss-up, and is on track to be decided by less than a 1% margin.
I don’t want to wake up on November 4th wondering what we could have done differently. Frankly, I’ve done that before. In 2014, I lost one of the most competitive and most expensive State Senate races Michigan has ever seen — a race that was decided by just 61 votes.
_61 votes is one more volunteer shift.
61 votes is a couple more hours of calling our neighbors.
61 votes is a handful of grassroots supporters giving $10._
I’ve learned a lot from that race, but the number one thing is this: even when you think you’ve given it your all, there is one more voter you can talk to, there is one more dollar you can scrounge up. There is always something you can do until the second polls close.

With just 3 days to go until Election Day, I’ve been thinking a lot about this race and what it means. Winning here in Michigan’s Fourth isn’t about some political win. It’s about fighting for our neighbors, putting an end to Trump’s corruption, and fixing a broken system. = | | = I’ve taken on corruption and special interests in Michigan before — and won. Instead of following “business-as-usual,” I want to give you 3 things

Instead of following “business-as-usual,” I want to give you 3 things
| Peter, I don't want to waste your valuable time, so I'll let you know right off the bat that this is a fundraising email. [Read my 3 promises to you, and then decide for yourself whether it's worth giving $10.](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)
Peter, I witnessed firsthand how politicians make promises on the campaign trail, and the moment their plane lands in Washington, they immediately forget to act on those promises to the people. Instead of following "business-as-usual," I want to give you 3 things I can promise you:
1. I promise to fight to ban congressional stock trading: My liberal opponent made over $21 MILLION trading stocks in Congress, and frankly, it's beyond corrupt. As members of Congress, our job is to serve YOU, not our wallets.
2. I promise to fight to end congressional pay during government shutdowns: Government shutdowns are the result of partisan bickering, so if members of Congress can't reach an agreement to fund the government, then we shouldn't get paid - if we don't do the job, we shouldn't get paid!
3. I promise to fight for term limits: Serving in Congress should be serving your country - not creating a lifelong career out of it. Take Nancy Pelosi - she's been in office for 39 years, serving the same lobbyists and big donors in Washington (not to mention trading stock and getting rich).
If you support my fight to clean up Washington, then [please consider chipping in $10 to support my campaign in this final stretch to Election Day.](https://trk.email.repdailyred._FBBo0nNYzlyU6mF10xuQ)

| [HELP ME CLEAN UP WASHINGTON](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)

If there was ever a time to give, [it's right now in these final days before Election Day.](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)
-Jen Kiggans

#
We send a decent number of fundraising emails -- although not nearly as many as some campaigns. I've always thought it was important to explain what those donations go toward. A lot of times, I'll just type it out in text.
Today, I want to show you.
First, we've received more than 2 million donations this election cycle from all across the country. We've received more donations from New York than any other state, but there's not a part of the country that isn't represented.
Here's a map of where those donations come from.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)
So what did we put each of those donations toward:
There was the Fighting Oligarchy Tour with Bernie Sanders with stops across the country including one in Folsom, California where more than 30,000 people showed up.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)
Those were dark times shortly after Trump's election. A lot of people didn't quite know what to do. But we organized and gave some much needed hope for people who were ready to act.
We helped California pass the Election Rigging Response Act, putting five more House seats in play this November after Republicans rigged the maps in Texas.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)
We traveled and made endorsements in some tough Democratic primaries where many of our candidates won. Think about some of the victories we had this cycle: Zohran Mamdani for Mayor of New York City (!), Analilia Mejia for Congress in New Jersey, Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania, Sam Forstag in Montana and the list goes on and on...
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)
We hired organizers in Tennessee and Florida to help elect Justin J. Pearson and Angie Nixon.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)
We made a $1 million contribution to help elect Abdul El-Sayed and Democrats up and down the ballot in Michigan.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)
We rallied at home in New York ... all across the state.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)
And New York is where we’re going to close things out with some big events in the final days of the election.
But remember, whatever happens on Tuesday is not the destination. It is just a point on our journey.
The destination is a new world, a better country -- one that prioritizes the dignity of all people. And that dignity looks like living wages; It looks like stable housing; It looks like guaranteed healthcare and respect for all of our differences, no matter who we are or where we come from.
And no matter if you're someone who has contributed $1, $100 or any other amount, there's a small piece of that donation in every single thing we've done this election cycle.
If you've volunteered to fill 1 shift, 100 shifts or anything else, there's a piece of our progress that is directly attributable to your work.
Let's win next Tuesday. And then let's keep going.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

* * *

**🇺🇸 Wait... before you click away ⛅️**
Alexandria is not running around the country begging billionaires for campaign contributions. Our work is funded by lots and lots of people making individual donations when they can, for whatever amount they can.
The donations we do receive go toward things like the organizers we've hired in Tennessee and Florida, toward events and travel when you see us holding things like the Fighting Oligarchy Tour, or time on the road supporting Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan and Emilia Sykes in her competitive House race in Ohio.
The donations we receive sometimes go toward donations we make to candidates like Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania before he won his primary -- and they go toward worthy causes like the Northeast Bronx Community Farmers Market Project or the Bronx River Houses Residents Association.
[Can you please make a contribution to support Alexandria's work today? Our average donation is around $16. Some give more. Some give less. There is a small piece of every donation made in all of the work our campaign does.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261031-12493-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=12493%2E2526796%2E4JVit_)

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Liberty across Mississippi – making the case for freedom in high schools
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/whyismssoawesome-12855311?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend, In recent years, Mississippi has deregulated its labor market, reformed school funding, and begun dismantling red tape. It has also become the first state since 1980 to pass legislation that puts it on a path to eliminate the income tax. **These are meaningful wins, but they will not endure if the next generation grows up believing in socialism.** Every reform we have secured could be undone in a single legislative session if young Mississippians are never taught how the free market actually works. At MCPP, our mission is not only to advance liberty today, but to ensure the next generation understands why freedom has, as Ronald Reagan said, lifted humanity “from the swamp to the stars.”
---
| |
---
Until now, most Mississippi students have had no access to a dedicated civics course. That is about to change. SB 2294, signed by Governor Reeves in April, requires every public and charter school to teach civics between eighth and twelfth grade beginning in the 2027–28 school year. The curriculum must focus on the “ideals, principles and spirit of political and economic democracy.”
---
| This is where MCPP’s latest initiative comes in. **We call it the Mississippi Liberty Pipeline, and it begins with the Liberty Roadshow.** **[CLICK HERE for details:](https://us.list-manage.com/qts9mJcmAK2?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)** Across five short sessions, we bring economic education directly into Mississippi high schools. The first centers on _I, Pencil_ —the story of how millions of people who have never met cooperate to produce something as ordinary as a pencil, with no one in charge. From there, students examine prices, property rights and the rule of law, free trade, and enterprise. Students do more than sit and listen. They examine what happens when prices are capped after a hurricane, figure out who actually pays for a tariff, and hear the strongest arguments on both sides before debating them. This is substantive economics, not advocacy. We trust the ideas to win on their merits. The program costs the school nothing. We provide the speakers, materials, activity kits, and travel; the school provides a room and the students. We are now booking visits for this school year. The most engaged students continue to our Liberty & Leadership Summit in Jackson, where they deepen their understanding of economic freedom and grow as leaders. From there, our Liberty Internships initiative gives promising young Mississippians direct experience in government, including placements in the offices of statewide elected officials.
---
| |
---
To make this possible, we have brought on Elle Elise Herrington as Liberty Outreach Coordinator. Since joining in September, she has been contacting schools and civics teachers across the state.

Here is how you can help. If you know a teacher, principal, or school board member, please forward them this email so they can request a visit at [mspolicy.org/roadshow-request](https://us.list-manage.com/UObFa5kHBqw?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3).
---
| If you know a student who should take part, Elle Elise would welcome an introduction at [elle@mspolicy.org](mailto:elle@mspolicy.org). Last month I wrote that we need to dedicate the next twenty-five years to ensuring a generation of Americans grows up appreciating why this is the greatest republic in human history—and why our way of life is worth defending. The Liberty Pipeline is how we intend to begin.
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://us.list-manage.com/eEaad0o3WVR?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3 "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy

|
---

Mississippi Center for Public Policy520 George StJackson, MS 39202-3013

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: $181 million vs. $35 million
body:
I wanted you to hear this from me first.
Peter, I wanted you to hear this from me first.
**A brand-new poll shows me leading Greg Abbott, 49% to 46%.**
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261031-1.jsvorf&refcode=em-20261031-1&t=1&akid=2241%2E1086043%2EvQWkpf)
Here’s why that number matters so much. In early October, we had cut Abbott’s lead to just 1.3 points. Then the polls started moving back his way. His lead in the polling average grew, and a lot of insiders decided this race was slipping away from us.
**_This poll was taken in the middle of early voting, and it shows us ahead._**
What makes it remarkable is this: Greg Abbott has now spent $181 million in this race, five times what our campaign has spent. In the last month alone, he spent $35 million. **That’s as much as we’ve spent since the day we launched.**
**_Spending: TX-GOV_**
🔴 Abbott, total: $181 million
🔴 Abbott, last 30 days: $35 million
🔵 Our entire campaign: $35 million
He has outspent us 5 to 1. **But we’re outworking him, and grassroots supporters are the reason why.**
I’m not going to pretend one poll settles anything. Three points is within the margin of error, and Abbott isn’t going to stop spending now. The voters who decide this race are about to be buried in his ads. **We have to make sure they hear from us too.**
**That’s why my team set a goal to raise $3 million this week, which would bring us to $10 million raised in October.** As of writing this, we’re 95% of the way there.
Supporters like you helped get us this far, and I need you with me for the final stretch. **[Will you split a contribution of $5 now between Wes Moore and my campaign to help us hit our $3 million goal and keep this lead through Election Day?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261031-1.jsvorf&refcode=em-20261031-1&t=2&akid=2241%2E1086043%2EvQWkpf)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261031-1.jsvorf&amount=5&refcode=em-20261031-1&t=21&akid=2241%2E1086043%2EvQWkpf)**
We closed a 7-point gap once already. Abbott has spent $181 million trying to stop us, and today we’re ahead. Let’s take Texas back.
Thank you for everything,
Gina

body:
| | | | Good morning, Peter! It’s Cait. Happy Saturday. We have three days to end Mike Lawler’s congressional career. We’ve got a big day of GOTV planned, so I’ve only got a minute, but I wanted to reach out before things got too hectic. Two things I want you to keep in mind today

subject: Today's the LAST DAY to vote early!
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Dave Beckwith For Congress_
body:
| | | | [](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
Hi Friend,
**Today is the last day of early voting in Virginia!**
****
****If you haven’t voted yet, today is your chance to make your voice heard before Election Day.
_This election is about more than politics, it's about what kind of future we leave for our kids and grandkids._
I’m fighting for a future where our **government is run efficiently** and within its means.
Where **wasteful and fraudulent spending is rooted out** and your tax dollars are spent responsibly.
Where you **keep more of your hard-earned money.**
Where **daily expenses are made more affordable** through smart policy decisions.
Where our **quality of life is made a priority** because data centers and transmission lines don't threaten our neighborhoods.
Where you **never have to ask the question "can I afford this?"** at the doctor's office.
Where our **communities are safe and secure.**
Where **women and girls remain saf** e in schools, sports, and private facilities.
Where we**keep our promises to the veterans** who served this country.
And where we can all **believe in the strength of our democratic institutions.**
__**This is the future I want for us. If you're with me, I need you to get out and vote!**__
If you don’t use your voice, you’re letting others decide your future for you.
Get out today and bring a neighbor, a friend, your family, or anyone else who hasn't voted yet! If you can’t make it today, Election Day is Tuesday, November 3.
Click below to find your early voting location.
[FIND MY POLLING PLACE](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
| | | I will fight hard in Congress to turn this vision into our reality, but I need your help to get there. Today and on November 3rd, get out and VOTE!
**VOTE EARLY. VOTE IN PERSON. VOTE DAVE BECKWITH.**
See you at the polls!

God Bless, Dave Beckwith
**Beckwith for Congress** _Restoring Faith in the American Dream_

body:
We’re not going to try to scare you into donating, or invent some ridiculous match, or pretend the sky is falling. That’s not the kind of team we’ve built together.
#

Good morning.
We’re going to be direct with you, because we owe you that.
Tonight, at midnight, is our end-of-month deadline. The last one before polls close on Tuesday. And as of this morning, we’re still short of our October goal.
We’re not going to try to scare you into donating, or invent some ridiculous match, or pretend the sky is falling. That’s not the kind of team we’ve built together.
Here’s the plain truth: What we raise today covers the final 72 hours of voter outreach in races that will be decided by thousands — maybe even hundreds — of votes. We’re talking about advertising, door knocking, texting, phone calls, chasing down ballots. What we don’t raise now is voters we don’t reach.
There’s no do-over after Tuesday. We don’t get a second try.

body:
Dear Peter,
Tonight marks Truth to Power’s last end-of-month fundraising deadline before Election Day. Right now, we are just $1,967 short of our goal.
I want to take a moment to explain exactly what’s at stake and why your support makes all the difference.
**But first, if you’re ready to stand with Truth to Power, click this link my team made for you to chip in $5 before midnight and help us reach our fundraising goal.**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_ttp_20261031_1_ak?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261031_1_ak.gmTUqF&refcode=em20261031-41627&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=41627%2E3422442%2EbwiOMZ)**
When some groups face a big deadline, they can count on a corporate PAC cutting them a massive check—trading their values to do that corporation’s bidding.
Truth to Power is different. Just like my own campaigns, we refuse every penny from corporate PACs. We believe true political change comes from grassroots power. The candidates we back will enter office unbought—they’re only accountable to the communities they serve.
**The money you give will go toward supporting our slate of endorsed candidates—spreading their message and turning out voters across the country before polls close on Tuesday.** If we reach our goal, we can expand those efforts. If we fall short, we’ll have to cut back.
This strategy works because small contributions add up fast. If everyone reading this email pitched in as little as $3, we would shatter our goal and deliver our slate the last-minute resources they need to win.
That’s why I’m turning to you today, Peter. Any amount, big or small, will help us take back Congress. **Can you give $3 or more to Truth to Power before our midnight fundraising deadline?**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_ttp_20261031_1_ak?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261031_1_ak.gmTUqF&refcode=em20261031-41627&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41627%2E3422442%2EbwiOMZ)**
Thank you,
Katie Porter

Former U.S. Congresswoman Katie Porter founded Truth to Power to support the campaigns of her fellow Democrats. Truth to Power supports candidates who will stand up to Donald Trump, fight to lower costs, and protect the environment. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20261031-41627&amounts=&t=3&refcode2=41627_3422442_bwiOMZ&akid=41627%2E3422442%2EbwiOMZ)**

As I write this email, one thing keeps going through my mind: **It 's now or never.**
**Our final end-of-month deadline is just hours away, and we 've set an ambitious $3 million goal. **That's what it will take to stand up to Roger Marshall and the super PACs supporting him. They've already poured millions into this race to flood the airwaves with attack ads against me. We must hit our goal to have the resources to fight back.
Our momentum over the past few months has been incredible. Multiple polls have shown me leading Roger Marshall, including a recent poll that has me up by 2 points. Election experts at Inside Elections just shifted this race to "Toss Up" status. And the New York Times called this one of the most competitive races in the country.
**This surge of support is all because of amazing supporters like you. It 's thanks to people like you that we had early fundraising success that helped us meet with Kansans across the state, spread our unifying message and draw national attention to this race. It's because of dedicated people like you that we have a narrow lead and have a real chance to win in 3 days.**
But now, with the final end-of-month deadline before the election just around the corner, we have to prove to Marshall, his allies and everyone watching that our momentum is still going strong. We have to show them, in no uncertain terms, that we are prepared to meet this moment and respond to whatever they throw at us.
**That 's why hitting our $3 million end-of-month goal is so crucial. We only have until midnight to prove that our grassroots movement has what it takes to win. I know from listening to Kansans all across the state that they're sick and tired of Roger Marshall letting them down over and over again.**
**[It's now or never. Please, will you give anything you can spare to help us hit this all-important goal and make sure we have what it takes to send Roger Marshall packing in 3 days? At this critical time, every dollar makes a difference.](https://substack.com/redirect/424382ed-c550-4b48-abe3-51c050129371?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
With your support -- and the support of thousands of people like you -- we can do this.
Thank you,
Adam

subject: Not the email I hoped to send today
body:

Peter – this isn't the email I hoped to send today, but I really have no other choice:
**Michael Whatley is re-upping his attacks against me on the airwaves, but we’re not on pace to raise the resources we need by midnight to fight back.**
If we miss tonight’s goal – the last end-of-month goal before Election Day – we may not have the funds to reach the last few undecided voters with our message before my opponent’s lies get to them first. [**_So before I go on, will you please chip in right now to help me close the gap?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1788&amount=5&t=8&akid=5141%2E124072%2ECRM7a5)

I didn’t enter this Senate race thinking it’d be easy, Peter.
President Trump has used his platform to smear me relentlessly, Washington DC Republicans have singled me out for defeat and far-right super PACs have written eight-figure checks to help buy Whatley’s way to victory.
That’s because Democrats can’t take back the Senate without flipping NC blue. No other campaign has been able to flip this seat since _2008,_ but experts say our grassroots movement is the best chance of changing that.
Unlike my opponent, though, I’m not counting on MAGA billionaires to throw me a last-minute lifeline to clinch this thing. **I’m relying on small-dollar support from folks like you.**
[**_Right now, I need you. Please, Peter, will you rush $5 for the first time to help me hit my goal before tonight’s *final* end-of-month deadline and win in North Carolina?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1788&amount=5&t=10&akid=5141%2E124072%2ECRM7a5)

A child's ZIP code should tell us where they live. It should not tell us how little we expect them to achieve.
Yet too often, when children struggle to read, the explanations arrive faster than the solutions. Poverty. Family circumstances. Funding. Another study. Another committee.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a332f787-1310-4fc4-8fd6-3f1ba3ae9aee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meanwhile, childhood does not pause.
**Mississippi 's progress in literacy challenges us to ask a harder question: What would it take for Philadelphia to write a different story for its children?**
That question brought us together for our 2nd annual **F3 Forum --Faith, Family & Future of Education in America**, under the theme:
**" Can Philadelphia Become the Next Mississippi Miracle?"**
If you missed it--or want to revisit the conversation--the video is now available.
▶️ **[Watch the forum here.](https://substack.com/redirect/a332f787-1310-4fc4-8fd6-3f1ba3ae9aee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We brought together educators, policy experts, pastors, parents, and community voices because improving education requires people willing to work across those lines.
Parents need answers they can act on. Educators need approaches that help children learn. And communities need to insist that children's potential matters more than adults' attachment to the way things have always been done.
**We cannot prepare children for the opportunities of tomorrow while accepting that they cannot read today.**
Artificial intelligence is accelerating. Work is changing. New opportunities are emerging. Our children deserve the preparation to take their share of that future.
Literacy is where that preparation begins.
**Watch the conversation. Then share it with a parent, teacher, pastor, school board member, or neighbor.** Ask them: What should we put into practice--and how can we help?
**[Watch"Can Philadelphia Become the Next Mississippi Miracle?"](https://substack.com/redirect/a332f787-1310-4fc4-8fd6-3f1ba3ae9aee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
And leave a comment: **What is one change you believe would make the greatest difference for Philadelphia 's children?**
Thank you to everyone who participated, attended, and supported this forum. Let's keep the conversation moving toward action.
Blessings...

clean_body: WATCH our 2nd annual F3 Forum--and help bring this conversation to more parents, educators, and community leaders. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more WATCH our 2nd annual F3 Forum--and help bring this conversation to more parents, educators, and community leaders. Oct 31 | | | | | | | | | | | A child's ZIP code should tell us where they live. It should not tell us how little we expect them to achieve. Yet too often, when children struggle to read, the explanations arrive faster than the solutions. Poverty. Family circumstances. Funding. Another study. Another committee. | | ---|---|--- Meanwhile, childhood does not pause. Mississippi 's progress in literacy challenges us to ask a harder question: What would it take for Philadelphia to write a different story for its children? That question brought us together for our 2nd annual F3 Forum --Faith, Family & Future of Education in America, under the theme: " Can Philadelphia Become the Next Mississippi Miracle?" If you missed it--or want to revisit the conversation--the video is now available. ▶️ We brought together educators, policy experts, pastors, parents, and community voices because improving education requires people willing to work across those lines. Parents need answers they can act on. Educators need approaches that help children learn. And communities need to insist that children's potential matters more than adults' attachment to the way things have always been done. We cannot prepare children for the opportunities of tomorrow while accepting that they cannot read today. Artificial intelligence is accelerating. Work is changing. New opportunities are emerging. Our children deserve the preparation to take their share of that future. Literacy is where that preparation begins. Watch the conversation. Then share it with a parent, teacher, pastor, school board member, or neighbor. Ask them: What should we put into practice--and how can we help? And leave a comment: What is one change you believe would make the greatest difference for Philadelphia 's children? Thank you to everyone who participated, attended, and supported this forum. Let's keep the conversation moving toward action. Blessings... Let's get to work! | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Kathy Barnette Seed & Roots Initiatives, P.O.
